item.title: Building My Smart Home: Home Assistant Made Easy with Claude Code
item.description: As a long-time Home Assistant user, I’ve always dreamed of making every possible device in my new home “smart.” I’ve shared parts of my setup before, but the truth is HA has a real learning curve, and long-term maintenance brings its own headaches:
